# Code of Conduct

This project follows the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
in short form.

## Our pledge

We want everyone to be able to take part in this project without harassment, whatever their age, background,
identity, experience, nationality or language. Please be kind: this is a small fan project made in free time.

## What we expect

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people new to the game or to GitHub.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person, and accept feedback the same way.
- Write in whatever language you are comfortable with. English or Russian gets the fastest answer.

## What is not acceptable

- Insults, harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Sexualised language or attention, or publishing other people's private information.
- Spam, or anything else that would reasonably be seen as inappropriate here.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, issues and pull requests that break these rules, and may block
people who keep doing so.

To report a problem, use [GitHub's private report option](https://github.com/Topl1nk/nms-crafting-guide/security/advisories/new)
or message the maintainer through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Topl1nk). Reports are kept private.
